dispositions.reason: The source explicitly leaves the ghost-user role/access exception unresolved. Current role storage requires a non-null authenticated user_id and supports only manager/user roles; no implemented ghost flow or approved durable policy was found.

Current migration evidence establishes class_kit.users as an authenticated product-membership table keyed by (product_id, user_id), not a customer record. The proposed customer-ID evolution and migration scope remain an explicitly open product decision.
Copy-once profile synchronization is presented as a recommendation awaiting approval. No implemented linked-customer model or explicit current policy resolving that choice was found.

The proposed customer_id canonicalization and user_id compatibility translation are not present in current migrations, API source, SDK source, or canonical documentation; the source itself says approval is pending.

Deactivate/reactivate and audited merge are unapproved customer-lifecycle proposals. Current product-user storage includes active/inactive status, but that does not settle the proposed customer-history and duplicate-merge policy.

The exactly-one product-customer/backfill workflow is an unaccepted proposal. Current code documents product-user access activation, but no product_customer table or transactional customer-creation implementation was found.

The proposed separation of customer management from application-access management, including explicit audited ghost linking, remains in-flight design work. Existing product access and role contracts do not establish the proposed customer resource boundary.

Product membership is currently scoped by (product_id, user_id), but the privacy-sensitive rule forbidding cross-product match revelation or linking is posed as an open policy and has no explicit implemented customer-linking contract to promote.
This is an engineering/product-decision handoff, not evidence of an adopted Project Memory contract. It requires explicit policy selection before implementation or documentation changes.

Current API implementation and regression-test source verify structured snapshots and permission-gated autocomplete, while current SDK source contains no locations facade. The final wiki already documents the backend contract, free-text fallback, attribution rule, and that applications must wait for a released facade. No release evidence supports a change. The inspected repository identity conflicts with target-repo/docs/repositories/structure.md's local-only/no-origin claim; identity remains run evidence and was not used to alter canonical prose.

This asks for an explicit product-owner decision and possible migration work. Current evidence shows the physical class_kit.users membership table; it does not authorize documenting a rename as durable fact.
This is a request to settle an unapproved synchronization policy before implementation, rather than durable evidence for Project Memory maintenance.
